scope: Local PERM download/import/offline query and independent preview; no Daily Scan or Career-Ops writes
failure_modes: Missing/duplicate required headers, unknown statuses, empty data sheets
Missing or invalid dates; negative durations are excluded but cases retained
Duplicate cumulative quarters for a fiscal year; FY2025 requires full Q4
Duplicate cases across releases; latest decision then release wins
Conflicting same-release same-date case rows block publication
Suffix-only, substring, parent/subsidiary and same-name/different-location matches must not silently aggregate
Missing cache; invalid current/manifest/database; offline query must remain read-only
Concurrent writer lock; failed imports must preserve previous pointer
Data paths through symlinks or outside checkout are rejected
Unverified scored-company selection cannot generate a preview
Official HTTPS hosts/redirects only; download signatures and length checked
Alias duplicate normalized source names, invalid statuses/scopes, empty verified targets, invalid target names/locations, and dangling evidence IDs must fail before statistics
Missing/out-of-bounds/symlink evidence, absent quotes or invalid URLs/dates must fail closed
Posting-scoped aliases require the original verified posting key and URL; same short brand with another job cannot inherit statistics
Multiple verified target entities remain separate; no implicit parent/subsidiary aggregate
Saved preview freezes registry and evidence; later changes cannot reinterpret or overwrite it
Company-history identities must use company scope; absent disclosures must not require an invented address, while existing records still require explicit locations
acceptance: Synthetic two-year workbook import yields hand-calculated four-status counts, rates, quartiles and complete dimension groups
Cross-release correction deduplicates; latest-decision-year attribution retained
Exact legal matches only; trade-only candidates require independent identity evidence; suffix candidates remain suggestions; ambiguous names have no statistics
Every failure preserves current pointer and prior offline query
Preview validates scored evidence presence and emits JSON, Markdown, manifest and selection
All fixtures and command/stdout/stderr/assertion evidence remain in isolated reproducible artifact
Evidence-backed alias query respects company or original posting scope; disclosed records always need explicit target locations
Alias preview freezes registry/evidence content while preserving original company and posting provenance
All registry corruption cases fail before trusted statistics and retain existing previews unchanged
Import, aliases, query and preview work without content checksums; output excludes legacy checksum fields while source quotes and posting scope remain enforced
